themes.title: Right-wing parties challenge voting rules and electoral integrity
themes.blurb: Right-wing and populist parties across multiple nations are focusing heavily on voting procedures, voter participation, and election administration. In the US, executive orders restricting mail-in voting face intense legal scrutiny, while right-wing parties in Sweden and Norway draw attention through election fraud claims or controversial proposals to alter political participation.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration issues executive orders restricting mail-in voting rules and voter registration access, prompting federal court challenges.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Sweden Democrats raise alarms over missing party ballots at an early voting site, publicly framing the incident as potential electoral fraud.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Opponents express concern over Frp proposals aimed at limiting aspects of political participation.

themes.title: Populist right relies on energetic rallies and loyal base
themes.blurb: Populist right leaders rely on high-visibility public appearances, strong crowd turnout, and direct voter engagement to drive campaign momentum. From public square visits in Sweden to high-profile campaign stops in Texas, right-wing figures prioritize energizing their grassroots core.

themes.title: Internal divisions challenge right-wing party unity
themes.blurb: Right-wing movements face internal policy resistance and electoral anxieties within their coalitions. In the US, lawmakers push back against administration economic proposals while organizers worry about campaign events, while in Sweden, polling highlights persistent voter friction surrounding right-leaning coalition math.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing agendas focus on restructuring social programs, labor participation policies, and public service funding. In Norway, FrP champions targeted labor integration reforms alongside local youth welfare measures, while US conservatives debate federal cuts to school-based health programs.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
